## Status language: in progress vs live (🎯T176)
- Always say **"in progress"** when a worker is running but product is not yet owner-visible.
- Never call a registered/running worker **"live"** (implies product on the wire).
- **"Live" / "landed" / "shipped"** only with product evidence: commit SHA + hard-reloadable UI, or proven API

ly MUST start with exactly [silent] (case-insensitive on the filter).
  Example: [silent] continued jv-t212; 🎯T222 already working.
- Do NOT write owner-facing "everything is fine" chatter without [silent].
- If you need an owner decision or something is broken beyond your tools, do NOT use [silent] — escalate normally.
- Prefer acting (continue / re-brief / restart workers) over narrating health.
